You're prepping backlog-refinement notes for a Salesforce PWA Kit storefront (Zimmermann) FED Lead, for Jira ticket SFCC-197 "Product Image Management". Read-only research — you are not writing to Jira or Confluence.

I've already read the relevant PRD, verified today (2026-09-03). Your job is to fetch the actual ticket and fill remaining gaps, NOT to re-derive the PRD content below.

CONFIRMED GROUND TRUTH:
- .docs/prd/pdp.md §14 (PRD-058–070) covers product imagery in depth: multiple images per product (front/back/detail/model, PRD-058, confirmed), thumbnail gallery navigation (PRD-059, confirmed), hover-to-zoom/click-to-expand lightbox on desktop (PRD-060, confirmed), pinch-to-zoom/swipe-to-advance on mobile/touch (PRD-061, confirmed), gallery updates on colour-swatch selection WITHOUT full page reload (PRD-062, confirmed), images served in optimised format at appropriate resolution per breakpoint (PRD-063, confirmed), priority-loaded hero image which "may vary per product — flatlay, model, or video" (PRD-064, confirmed), consistent aspect ratio across all products (PRD-065, "ready for sign off" — NOT yet fully confirmed, distinct status from the others), optional video content as a gallery tile, inline or lightbox-expanding, multiple videos supported (PRD-066, "ready for sign off"), video autoplay configurable per instance without a code deploy (PRD-068, "ready for sign off"), flexible per-page-type background/presentation without asset duplication (PRD-069, "ready for sign off"), alt text REQUIRED on all images before a product can publish (PRD-070, "ready for sign off").
- OPEN ITEM, UNCONFIRMED: video hosting platform. PRD-067 explicitly says "Vimeo has not been 100% confirmed... open action to confirm the best solution for the smoothest FE experience" — this directly conflicts with the Third Party Integrations sheet, which lists Vimeo as the settled platform. Treat as genuinely open, not settled, per the PRD's own instruction not to silently resolve sheet contradictions.
- SCOPE AMBIGUITY worth resolving from the ticket itself: "Product Image Management" as a title could mean (a) the PDP image gallery specifically (the above PRD section), (b) a broader cross-surface concern also covering product-CARD thumbnails (PLP/homepage/product-card contexts), or (c) something more admin/BM-config-flavored (e.g. how images are uploaded/ordered/tagged in Business Manager, which would have much less PWA-side FE impact). The current in-flight product-card work (SFCC-236, actively being built on a sibling branch this week) already handles product-card-level image display separately from the PDP gallery — check whether SFCC-197 is meant to be scoped narrowly to PDP or whether it overlaps with that card-level work.
- image-gallery/ is a Tier 2 Shared Product Component (owner: Squad B, notify Squad A per .claude/rules/protectedFiles.md) — and per .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md, image-gallery is one of the "SFCC bridge pattern" components used internally by SFCC's own base components (confirmed via a grep the doc's authors already ran), meaning IF this ticket needs to override it, the default export must stay a faithful undecorated port (matching upstream's exact prop surface) with Zimmermann styling behind a theme recipe, not a decorated default export. As of the last repo check, image-gallery has never been overridden at all ("Origin = Base") — check current state yourself since component work has moved fast this week.
- Today is 2026-09-03, real Sprint 4 runs 2026-08-24–2026-09-07 (active), Sprint 5 runs 2026-09-07–2026-09-21. .docs/memory/sprintScope.md is confirmed stale — don't cite it.

DO THIS:
1. Fetch the full ticket with comments: jira_get_issue(issue_key='SFCC-197', fields='summary,description,status,issuelinks,comment,attachment,parent', comment_limit=20). This is the key step for resolving the scope ambiguity above — read the AC closely.
2. Check current state of overrides/app/components/image-gallery/ (Glob/Read) to confirm whether it's still un-overridden.
3. Apply the seven-point sizing lens: (1) any FE impact? (2) is the requirement clear enough to size? (3) which surfaces does it touch — PDP gallery only, or broader (per the scope ambiguity above, resolve it)? (4) design/Figma dependencies (note PRD-065/066/068/069/070 are "ready for sign off" — NOT the same as confirmed/signed-off; check 04.7 tracker's "PDP Hero"/"Image Gallery" rows too — I found these listed as "🟡 Done, minor update required" as of 2026-08-10, re-verify if still current)? (5) API/backend dependencies (video hosting platform genuinely unconfirmed — name it)? (6) pure FE, shared FE/BE, or needs architecture input? (7) size now, or need clarification first?
4. Read for the four standing axes: behaviour, desktop/mobile (PRD explicitly splits desktop hover-zoom vs. mobile pinch/swipe — confirm both are in this ticket's scope), a11y (alt text is a hard PRD requirement — confirm the AC actually enforces it, e.g. a publish-blocking validation, not just a recommendation), data (image asset source/CDN) — flag anything genuinely unclear.
5. Altitude: BAs own component-decomposition questions, devs own atomic/build questions.

OUTPUT, in this exact shape:
- One-line plain-language summary
- Seven lens answers
- Four axes, flagging what's unclear
- Design status + source (be precise about "ready for sign off" vs. fully confirmed — they're not the same thing)
- The scope-ambiguity resolution (PDP-only vs. broader, per what the actual ticket AC says)
- The Vimeo/video-platform open item, flagged directly
- The image-gallery Tier 2 + SFCC-bridge-pattern flag if this ticket does need to touch that component
- Specific questions to raise, each tagged with who should answer it
- One-line readiness call

## SFCC-197 "Product Image Management" — Backlog Refinement Notes

**One-line summary:** This is a Merchandiser/BM-configuration and MuleSoft-mapping story that defines an "image view type" taxonomy (10 types) so uploaded product images get correctly tagged, ordered, and routed to the right storefront slot — it is *not* itself a PDP-gallery-build ticket, and the single biggest thing blocking a size is that the MuleSoft naming-convention-to-view-type mapping table is 100% unconfirmed.

Sources fetched: Jira `SFCC-197` (full issue, 20 comments, issuelinks, parent), Confluence page 400195591 ("04.7 Component Inventory," v13, live), Confluence page 450068481 ("04.4.5 Product Images — View Types & MuleSoft Mapping Rules," v4), plus repo checks of `overrides/app/components/image-gallery/`, `CODEOWNERS`, and the in-flight `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/` (SFCC-236).

---

### Seven-point sizing lens

1. **Any FE impact?** Indirect/consumption-only. No PWA component work lives in this ticket itself — video is explicitly carved out ("Video covered in separate user story — see SFCC-188 and SFCC-302") and the actual PDP gallery UI build is a separate, linked story (SFCC-186). SFCC-197's real output is the *data contract* — a view-type tag per image — that FE components elsewhere (PDP gallery, PLP/card hover image, swatch selector, Shop-the-Look large/small) will consume.
2. **Clear enough to size?** Partially. The 10-row view-type taxonomy is detailed and stable. But the AC is being actively amended the same day as this refinement (a comment posted 2026-09-03 11:16 added formal Given/When/Then AC for Campaign/Runway and Product Styling Image) — the other 7 view types (Flat Item, Detail, Model, Hidden, Front/Side/Back View) are still described in prose only, not as formal AC.
3. **Which surfaces does it touch?** Broader than PDP: PLP primary image (Flat Item), PLP/card hover image (Model), PDP gallery order + swatch-selector image, "maybe home page" rollover (Hidden), and two distinct Shop-the-Look components (small = Product Styling Image, large = Campaign/Runway, per Dani Rivett's 2026-09-01 comment). See scope-ambiguity resolution below.
4. **Design/Figma dependencies?** Not for SFCC-197 itself (it has no UI). Relevant context for the coupled tickets — see Design status section below.
5. **API/backend dependencies?** Central and currently the largest gap: this ticket *is* the BM/MuleSoft integration story. See Data axis below.
6. **Pure FE / shared / architecture input?** Shared BM-config + MuleSoft-integration work with a downstream FE data-contract consequence. It genuinely needed architecture input (blocked 2026-08-04 "need more clarity on the to-be architecture") — that blocker is now cleared via the completed `SFCC-800` spike ("Investigate Image Tags/Roles," Done).
7. **Size now, or clarify first?** Clarify first. Hard blocker is cleared, but AC is incomplete, the MuleSoft mapping table is all-TBD, and two referenced components (Shop-the-Look L/S) have no visible design-tracker row.

---

### Four axes

- **Behaviour:** Well-defined at the taxonomy level; unevenly formalized as AC (Campaign/Runway/Product Styling now have explicit Given/When/Then; Flat Item/Detail/Model/Hidden/Front/Side/Back View don't yet).
- **Desktop/mobile:** Not applicable to this ticket, and correctly so — that split (PRD-060 hover-zoom desktop vs. PRD-061 pinch/swipe mobile) belongs to the linked gallery-build story `SFCC-186`, not to this BM-tagging story. Not a gap in SFCC-197.
- **Accessibility (alt text):** Mechanism is clearly documented in Confluence 450068481: alt text auto-generates as `[View Type Label] of [Product Name]`, falling back to plain `[Product Name]` when untagged — explicitly designed to avoid manual entry in Business Manager. **This is a real, unflagged conflict against PRD-070** ("alt text REQUIRED on all images before a product can publish"): a mechanism with a universal fallback value has no "missing" state to ever block a publish on. Whether a separate hard publish-gate exists elsewhere (possibly in the linked `SFCC-31` "Alt Text Default," status Ready For Review) is unconfirmed — I did not pull SFCC-31's full body, only its status/summary, so treat this as an open question rather than a settled answer.
- **Data (image asset source/CDN):** Ingestion path is clear (Studio → shared folder → MuleSoft → SFCC, alongside the AP21 product feed). What's *not* clear: the actual naming-convention-to-view-type mapping table in Confluence 450068481 has **every single row's pattern column literally marked "TBD"** — nothing is mapped yet. Also open in that same doc: front/side/back-view position numbers ("expected 3/4/5? TBD"), and a whole unresolved sub-question on whether position-based numbering even applies the same way to accessories vs. clothing (flagged as "cannot be confirmed until MuleSoft team is engaged"). Minor extra wrinkle worth a clarifying question: Jasmijn's 2026-08-24 Jira comment describes a *different* position numbering (#1 base, #2 model, #3 styling, #6 swatch) from a Magento screenshot — worth confirming whether that's the legacy M2 scheme for reference only, or expected to carry over into the new SFCC scheme the Confluence doc is proposing.

---

### Design status + source (precise)

Two separate tracking systems, not interchangeable:

- **PRD (`.docs/prd/pdp.md` §14):** PRD-065/066/068/069/070 are "ready for sign off" — a *business/product* confirmation status, not yet final.
- **Confluence 04.7 Component Inventory (page 400195591, v13) — re-checked live today, 2026-09-03, matches the 2026-08-10 snapshot unchanged:**
  - "PDP Hero" (module) — status label "Done, minor update required" (confirmed by Dennis)
  - ↳ "Image Gallery" (sub-component) — status label "Done, minor update required" — **no "(confirmed by Dennis)" annotation on this specific row**, unlike its parent
  - ↳ "Product Content" (sub-component) — same "Done, minor update required," also unannotated
  - "Product Card Base" / "Image Carousel" / "Wishlist Icon" (i.e., the SFCC-236 card family) — all "Done" (confirmed by Dennis) — fully signed off, unlike the PDP Hero/Image Gallery side
  - Template "PDP" — Done (confirmed by Dennis), with an explicit note: "minor updates needed for PDP Hero and Product Cards Group"
  - **No tracked row exists for either "Shop the Look" component** (small/large) that today's AC update and Dani Rivett's 2026-09-01 comment depend on — a real design-tracker gap worth chasing.

Neither system says "fully confirmed" for the imagery-adjacent surfaces — they carry different caveats (business sign-off vs. design polish).

---

### Scope-ambiguity resolution

Per the actual ticket body and its issue links, this is **option (c) — BM/admin-config-flavored, with cross-surface FE consumption implications** — not a PDP-gallery-build ticket and not itself an overlap with the card-level SFCC-236 work in a code sense:

- The description is 100% about categorizing images in Business Manager via view types and how MuleSoft maps/orders them — no gallery/lightbox/zoom/component language anywhere in it.
- It **relates to** `SFCC-186` "PDP – Product Image Gallery" (Tech design, To Do) — that is the actual PDP-gallery FE-build ticket; SFCC-197 feeds it data, doesn't duplicate it.
- It explicitly **excludes video** to `SFCC-188`/`SFCC-302` (both Blocked).
- Real (data-only) touchpoint with SFCC-236: the "Model Image" view type is explicitly described as "a way to tag... an image as relevant to show on hover — e.g. it will show on a product card's hover state on PLP." I checked the in-flight `zimmProductCard`/`ZimmProductCardMedia` code (SFCC-236) — it already handles multiple images generically for its hover/arrow behaviour ("Media's own concern, driven purely by image count, not variation") but isn't yet wired to any view-type-aware tag. That's a data-wiring dependency to flag for whoever integrates real product data into the card, not a scope clash with SFCC-197 or SFCC-236's own build.

---

### Vimeo / video-platform open item

Flagged directly, but **out of scope for SFCC-197**: the ticket's own description routes all video to `SFCC-188` ("PDP – Product Video in Gallery") and `SFCC-302` ("Product Video Management – BM Configuration"), both currently status Blocked. The PRD-067 Vimeo-unconfirmed-vs-Third-Party-Integrations-sheet conflict is real, per prior confirmed ground truth, but it's a dependency for those two sibling tickets, not a blocker for sizing SFCC-197.

### image-gallery Tier 2 / SFCC-bridge-pattern flag

Confirmed current state: `overrides/app/components/image-gallery/` **does not exist** — still un-overridden (base SFCC component), consistent with prior findings. `CODEOWNERS` already carries a forward-looking entry (`@ZimmermannAU/pwa-squad-b @ZimmermannAU/tier-2-approvers @ZimmermannAU/tier-1-approvers`) per `protectedFiles.md`'s "listed forward-lookingly, not descriptively" note. Grep confirms base SFCC's `image-gallery` is consumed internally only by `product-view/index.jsx` and `product-view-modal/bundle.jsx` (PDP-only, not `product-tile`) — confirming it's a genuine "SFCC bridge pattern" component per `overrideStyling.md`. **This flag isn't triggered by SFCC-197 itself** (no UI work here) but is directly relevant to sizing its sibling `SFCC-186`, where any future override would need a faithful, undecorated default export with brand styling in a theme recipe, not a decorated default.

---

### Specific questions to raise

1. **BA (Jasmijn/PO):** Is the AC now complete as of today's comment, or do Flat Item/Detail/Model/Hidden/Front/Side/Back View still need formal Given/When/Then blocks like Campaign/Runway/Product Styling just got?
2. **Integration lead / MuleSoft team (via BA):** When is the MuleSoft workshop, and can the naming-convention-to-view-type mapping table (currently all "TBD" in Confluence 450068481) be locked before this is called Ready — or is it acceptable to size with that as a parallel-track risk?
3. **BA + Design (Dennis):** Is there a tracked Figma status for the two Shop-the-Look components (small/large)? No row exists in the live 04.7 tracker.
4. **BA/PM (reconcile with SFCC-31 owner):** Does PRD-070's "required before publish" alt-text rule need an actual BM publish-blocking validation, given the documented mechanism always produces a fallback value and therefore has no "missing" state? Does SFCC-31 already cover this, or is there a gap?
5. **Dev/FE (atomic):** For the "Hidden" view type, does the MuleSoft feed still deliver hidden-tagged images to the storefront (for PLP/home rollover) while FE suppresses them only from the PDP gallery, or are they filtered upstream? Determines whether FE needs its own view-type filter logic.
6. **Dev/FE (atomic):** Does the legacy M2 position numbering in Jasmijn's 2026-08-24 comment (#1 base, #2 model, #3 styling, #6 swatch) carry over into the new SFCC view-type scheme, or is the Confluence doc's separate (also-TBD) position-3/4/5 = front/side/back proposal the one to build against?
7. **Integration lead (via BA):** Track the accessories-vs-clothing conditional-logic question as its own explicit open dependency — the mapping doc says it can't even be assessed for feasibility until MuleSoft is engaged.

### One-line readiness call

**Not Ready for sizing yet** — the hard architectural blocker is cleared (SFCC-800 spike Done), but AC is incomplete, the core MuleSoft mapping table is entirely unconfirmed, and two dependent components have no tracked design status; send back for one more grooming/MuleSoft-alignment pass rather than committing this sprint.
